author: Klaudeh

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: So. . . Yeah it’s just a box, nothing more. Except the fact it’s a challenge map! This box has 4 different spawn for players, soulboxes, bob, and this dude run a lot. So i hope you enjoy playing this weird and fun map haha it got plenty of space to run and walk so there’s no excuse to let bob kill you. Btw this map has a panzer so be careful , there’s no much weapons to buy at the start but don’t ya worry because when you get more far on the map there will be more wall weapons and the box to get a good weapon to defend yourself! Bugs fixes / New stuff: – Fixed text not updating when power is turned on – Fixed spawns for 3 or more players – Now you can drop at the double tap stairs in any place if you opened the last door – Deleted a couple soulboxes so there aren’t to many of then – Added new wall buys in the upper zone – Added new heads locations – Added more boxes to the map! This map features: – Custom Weapons from BO1, BO2 and BO3 – Bo1, Bo2 and Bo3 Perks – 3 hits system – Box zombies (Bob) – Bo2 HUD (kinda) – Power up customs (Random Perk Power Up, Random Power Up) – Custom Player Model and Hands – Sprinters – Hug Fix and Bo1 knife – Buyable ending – Custom Camo – Hitmarkers – Colored zombie counter – Added recoil and balance to weapon movement – Rotating Doors – One Especial RayGun – Collectibles for the ending door – Soul Boxes – PanzerSoldat Credits: – Shippuden1592 (Power up Money, Soul Boxes) – Ricko0z (Bo3 Weapons, Bo2 Weapons and Bo1 Weapons) – BluntStuffy (Panzer

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).
